title: Complex QA & language models hybrid architectures, Survey

bias_targets.methodology: Reviewing holistic benchmark suites (e.g., HELM) that measure disparities in model accuracy, robustness, and fairness when demographic metadata is available across different topics, domains, and contexts.
Examining the limitations of 'LLM-as-judge' automated evaluation paradigms, specifically noting how evaluator models can exhibit position bias or inherently favor their own generating styles.
Analyzing labeler biases introduced during Reinforcement Learning from Human Feedback (RLHF), where prolonged human alignment training can skew a language model toward specific political views.
